H7842.name: Shaharaim
H7842.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7842.brief: Benjamite who had wives Hushim and Baara
H7842.short: Shaharaim, a Benjamite, had two wives, Hushim and Baara, and he sent them away.

H7841.name: Shehariah
H7841.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7841.short: Shehariah, a descendant of Benjamin in the genealogy of Saul.

H7886.name: Shiloh
H7886.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7886.brief: A name in Jacob's blessing on Judah
H7886.short: Shiloh, a term used in Jacob's prophetic blessing on Judah, possibly referring to a future ruler or a place of rest.

H7889.name: Shimon
H7889.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7889.brief: Son of Judah and descendant of Caleb.
H7889.short: Shimon was a son of Judah and a descendant of Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H7895.name: Shishak
H7895.desc: Pharaoh living at the time of United Monarchy
H7895.brief: Egyptian Pharaoh who invaded Judah during Rehoboam's reign.
H7895.short: Shishak was an Egyptian Pharaoh who invaded Judah during the reign of King Rehoboam and captured fortified cities.

H7861.name: Shitrai
H7861.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7861.brief: Sharonite in charge of King David's herds in Sharon.
H7861.short: Shitrai was a Sharonite who was in charge of King David's herds that grazed in the plain of Sharon.

H7877.name: Shiza
H7877.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7877.brief: Reubenite father of Adina, one of David's mighty warriors.
H7877.short: Shiza was a Reubenite, the father of Adina, who was one of David's mighty warriors.

H7803H.name: Shuthelah
H7803H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7803H.short: Shuthelah was an Ephraimite descendant, the son of Zabad, mentioned in the genealogy of Ephraim.

H7803G.name: Shuthelah
H7803G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7803G.brief: Son of Ephraim, ancestor of the Shuthelahite clan.
H7803G.short: Shuthelah was a son of Ephraim and the ancestor of the Shuthelahite clan within the tribe of Ephraim.

H7831.name: Shahazumah
H7831.short: Shahazumah was a town on the border of Issachar's territory (<ref="Josh. 19:22">Josh. 19:22</ref>).

H7884.name: Shihor-libnath
H7884.short: Shihor-libnath was a place that marked the boundary of the territory allotted to the tribe of Asher (<ref="Josh. 19:26">Josh. 19:26</ref>).

H7887.name: Shiloh
H7887.brief: Israelite sanctuary and assembly point during the judges' period
H7887.short: Shiloh was an important Israelite sanctuary and assembly point during the period of the judges, where the tabernacle was set up and the land was allotted to the tribes (<ref="Josh. 18:1, 8-10; 1Sam. 1:3, 9, 24; 2:14; 3:21; Jer. 7:12, 14">Josh. 18:1, 8-10; 1Sam. 1:3, 9, 24; 2:14; 3:21; Jer. 7:12, 14</ref>).

H7866.name: Shion
H7866.brief: Town in the territory of Issachar
H7866.short: Shion was a town allotted to the tribe of Issachar, mentioned along with Shunem, Hapharaim, and Anaharath (<ref="Josh. 19:19">Josh. 19:19</ref>).

H7851G.name: Shittim
H7851G.brief: The last Israelite campsite before crossing the Jordan.
H7851G.short: Shittim, also called Abel-shittim, the final Israelite encampment before entering Canaan.

H7851H.name: Shittim Valley
H7851H.short: The Shittim Valley is mentioned in Joel's prophecy as a place where water will flow when God restores Judah's fortunes (<ref="Jol.3.18">Jol.3.18</ref>).

H7856.name: Sitnah
H7856.brief: Well dug by Isaac, disputed by Philistines
H7856.short: Sitnah was a well dug by Isaac in the Valley of Gerar, but the Philistines disputed its ownership (<ref="Gen. 26:21">Gen. 26:21</ref>).

H7800.name: Susa
H7800.brief: Capital city of the Persian Empire
H7800.short: Susa, the capital city of the Persian Empire, where Esther lived and the events of her book took place (<ref="Esth. 1:2; Dan. 8:2">Esth. 1:2; Dan. 8:2</ref>).

H7854.name: Satan
H7854.brief: The adversary, the devil, the tempter of humanity
H7854.short: Satan, meaning "adversary" or "accuser," is the devil, the chief enemy of God and tempter of humanity, who seeks to hinder God's purposes and lead people into sin (<ref="Job.1.6-12; Matthew 4:1-11; Revelation 12:9">Job.1.6-12; Matthew 4:1-11; Revelation 12:9</ref>).

H7802.name: Shushan Eduth
H7802.brief: A musical term or tune in the title of Psalm 60
H7802.short: Shushan Eduth, meaning "Lily of the Testimony," is a musical term or tune mentioned in the title of Psalm 60, possibly referring to a specific melody or musical setting.
